name: Quantify Amyloid Beta Plaques
description: Analyzes an image to detect and quantify amyloid-beta plaques, returning a detailed analysis log.
detailed_description: Analyzes an image to detect and quantify amyloid-beta plaques, returning a detailed analysis log.
when_to_use: When you need quantify amyloid beta plaques analysis

parameters.image_path: [Required] Path to the image file to be analyzed for amyloid-beta plaques (str)
parameters.output_dir: [Optional] Directory where results will be saved (default: ./results)
parameters.threshold_method: [Optional] Method for image thresholding (otsu, adaptive, or manual) (default: otsu)
parameters.min_plaque_size: [Optional] Minimum size in pixels² for a region to be considered a plaque (default: 50)
parameters.manual_threshold: [Optional] Threshold value to use when threshold_method is manual (default: 127)
